items_flat.title_en: Microsoft unveils Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot
items_flat.title_zh: 微軟發表 Copilot：Home、Code 與常駐 Autopilot
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft officially launched a redesigned Copilot app that combines chat (Home), natural-language software building (Code, same stack as GitHub Copilot), and Autopilot—the former Scout agent, now a persistent digital teammate with its own identity, memory and workspace inside a customer tenant. Home and Code begin rolling out in the Frontier program in coming weeks; Autopilot enters private preview at month-end.
items_flat.summary_zh: 微軟正式推出重整後的 Copilot：Home 聊天、以自然語言建應用的 Code（底層與 GitHub Copilot 相同），以及由 Scout 更名的 Autopilot——在客戶租戶內擁有獨立身分、記憶與工作區、可在使用者離開後持續工作的常駐代理人。Home／Code 將於未來數週進入 Frontier 計畫，Autopilot 月底進入私人預覽。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Microsoft’s bid to keep enterprise agent work inside M365 identity and governance rather than losing it to ChatGPT Work or Claude. Availability is still preview-gated, so adoption—and whether Autopilot’s permissions model actually calms IT risk—remain unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是微軟把企業代理人工作鎖在 M365 身分與治理內、對抗 ChatGPT Work／Claude 的產品回應。目前仍屬預覽，能否真正降低 IT 風險、帶動採用，仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: Autopilot, previously called Scout, is your digital teammate. Give it a name, a role and a goal, and it goes to work — watching channels, following up on threads, running recurring work and picking a project back up days later, without waiting for a prompt.
items_flat.quote_zh: Autopilot（原名 Scout）是你的數位隊友。給它名字、角色與目標，它就會開始工作——監看頻道、追蹤討論串、執行例行任務，並在數天後自行接回專案，不必等待提示。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic founders seek 50.1% voting control ahead of IPO
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 創辦人擬在 IPO 前取得 50.1% 投票權
items_flat.summary_en: The Information reported, and Reuters and TechCrunch corroborated, that Anthropic will ask shareholders to approve Palantir-style special shares giving CEO Dario Amodei and six co-founders a combined 50.1% vote on most matters if at least three retain a minimum stake. The Long-Term Benefit Trust would still choose most of the board; employees would get a tie-breaker share class. Anthropic did not immediately comment.
items_flat.summary_zh: 《The Information》報導、路透與 TechCrunch 證實：Anthropic 將請股東批准類似 Palantir 的特別股，讓 CEO Dario Amodei 與六位共同創辦人在至少三人維持最低持股時，合計握有多數事項 50.1% 投票權。長期利益信託仍主導多數董事席次；員工另獲可在部分議題扮演關鍵票的股份。公司暫未評論。
items_flat.analysis_en: The structure tries to keep a safety-mission board and founder control after a mega-IPO while founders hold small economic stakes. It is still a proposal, not an approved charter change, and board elections would remain an exception.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此設計試圖在創辦人經濟持股偏低的情況下，於巨型 IPO 後同時保住安全使命董事會與創辦人控制權。目前仍是提案、尚未通過章程，且董事選舉被列為例外。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic is asking shareholders to approve a new corporate structure that would award CEO Dario Amodei and his six co-founders a combined 50.1% of voting power.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 正請股東批准新的公司結構，讓執行長 Dario Amodei 與六位共同創辦人合計獲得 50.1% 投票權。

items_flat.title_en: D.C. Circuit upholds Pentagon supply-chain exclusion of Claude
items_flat.title_zh: 華府巡迴法院維持五角大廈將 Claude 列為供應鏈風險
items_flat.summary_en: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit on September 25 denied Anthropic’s petitions challenging the Department of War’s exclusion of Claude under the Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act. The majority said the Department had ample support after Anthropic refused to relax contractual bans on lethal autonomous warfare and domestic surveillance. Judge Henderson dissented on the statutory definition of “supply chain risk.”
items_flat.summary_zh: 美國哥倫比亞特區巡迴上訴法院於 9 月 25 日駁回 Anthropic 對戰爭部依《聯邦採購供應鏈安全法》排除 Claude 的挑戰。多數意見認為，在公司拒絕放寬對致命自主作戰與國內監控的契約禁令後，部會有充分依據。Henderson 法官就「供應鏈風險」法定定義提出異議。
items_flat.analysis_en: The ruling hardens a split between Anthropic’s use restrictions and U.S. defense procurement, separate from any commercial model launch. A contrary Northern District of California decision was distinguished; further appeals remain possible.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 判決固化 Anthropic 使用限制與美國國防採購之間的裂縫，與商業模型發布是不同戰場。法院區隔了北加州地院先前不同結論；後續上訴仍有可能。
items_flat.quote: We reject these challenges. The Department had ample support for its conclusion that the continued integration of Claude into the Department’s information systems… presented a statutorily covered national-security risk.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們駁回這些挑戰。部會有充分依據認定，持續將 Claude 整合進部會資訊系統……構成法律所涵蓋的國家安全風險。

items_flat.title_en: Musk details Colossus 2 path to ~1.2 million Nvidia GPUs
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克公布 Colossus 2 邁向約 120 萬顆 Nvidia GPU 時程
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that Colossus 2 currently runs 110,000 GB200 and 440,000 GB300 chips, with another 220,000 GB300 due next week, 220,000 in November, and a possible further 220,000 in late December “if we get lucky.” Combined with Colossus 1’s Hopper/Blackwell mix, Bloomberg and others framed a year-end cluster above 1.2 million GB200/GB300 processors.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 在 X 發文：Colossus 2 現有 11 萬顆 GB200 與 44 萬顆 GB300；再一批 22 萬顆 GB300 下週上線、11 月再 22 萬，若順利 12 月底再加 22 萬。彭博等將此解讀為年底 GB200／GB300 規模可逾 120 萬顆。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is a capacity schedule, not a model launch. Delivery still hinges on power, networking and Nvidia supply; Musk himself conditioned December on luck.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是算力時程、不是新模型發布。能否達標仍取決於電力、網路與 Nvidia 供貨；12 月那批連馬斯克都用「若幸運」當條件。
items_flat.quote: Colossus 2 is 110k GB200 and 440k GB300. Another 220k GB300 will be fully operational next week and another 220k in November. If we get lucky, yet another 220k GB300 by late December.
items_flat.quote_zh: Colossus 2 現有 11 萬顆 GB200 與 44 萬顆 GB300。再一批 22 萬顆 GB300 下週全面運作，11 月再 22 萬。若幸運，12 月底還能再加 22 萬顆 GB300。

brief_en: Quiet official-model window. Microsoft shipped a Copilot super-app with Code and always-on Autopilot agents. Anthropic founders seek 50.1% IPO voting control; a D.C. Circuit ruling upheld the Pentagon’s supply-chain exclusion of Claude. Musk detailed Colossus 2’s path toward 1.2M Nvidia chips.
brief_zh: 模型發布空窗。微軟推出 Copilot 超級應用（Code＋常駐 Autopilot）。Anthropic 創辦人擬在 IPO 前取得 50.1% 投票權；華府巡迴法院維持五角大廈將 Claude 列為供應鏈風險。馬斯克公布 Colossus 2 衝向約 120 萬顆 Nvidia 晶片時程。
